steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona... Thank goodness you're okay!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You fooled Roy, huh? What a performance. How did you pull it off?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I just imagined how it'd feel if I actually lost you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Whoa, a method actor...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Where are the others?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Iwona's hurt. Bad... But she'll live.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona...

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Dejected clicking noises)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: She's the one who fought most like a warrior... She stood firm to the very end.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Justyna and Plastic's gone to deal with Platinum... We have to hurry and help them!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: No need. She's gone.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: We aren't so rusty that the two of us can't take her on. She's not that strong.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Where's Justyna...?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Today's matches must continue as normal. Is that understood?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: We've made sure the Major competition venues are fully operational.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Good. Keep the spectators calm. Tonight's match must go off without a hitch.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Remember. It's not just the audience. After all that ruckus, the directors will be paying keen attention to this event.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: If we perform well, we'll all get hefty bonuses. If not...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: And I appreciate your efforts, Mob.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Don't mention it! I'm honored to commentate tonight—

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I suppose it goes without saying, but pretend as though nothing had happened last night.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Of the four events tonight, the match between the Radiant Knight and Nightmare Knight would undoubtedly be the hottest one.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: However... After the Infected instigated an incident of such scale... the Board of Directors isn't very keen on letting the Radiant Knight continue her streak.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: So... they want the judges to disqualify her?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: We'll make a decision as the competition evolves, but you must 'convey' to the audience how reasonable it is once the judges make the call.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: As for the Blood Knight, we've already sent someone to work this out with the Crimson Chalice Knightclub. We should come to a decision on that matter soon.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: As for the matter on hand... the Radiant Knight and Nightmare Knight... They're just two maniacs.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Understood! I'll head off and prepare for the match!

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What's the matter? You look pale.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Darksteel disappeared after the blackout. All three of them.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: This is still confidential, but several of K.G.C.C. executives were assassinated during the blackout...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Things are hectic at the crime scene. All evidence points to the Infected, but... I don't think it was them. The Infected aren't that good.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: As we speak... something terrifying is slowly unfolding.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Armorless Union has betrayed us.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Batbayar, do you always have so much free time on your hands?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Look who's talking!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Aren't you a titled Major knight? You have no training grounds. You don't have so much as a home. Do you seriously wander the streets of the Grand Knight Territory day in and day out?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: When a hunter loses his way in the forest, he will naturally provide for himself and build himself a wooden shed.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You are standing in one of the greatest cities of the world right now...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: —City!
The unusual roar stuns the old knight.
Everyone in their vicinity are staring at them as though they are wild beasts of the forest.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The city... is a symbol of weakness.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Right after this civilization conquered barbarism, they built their tall towers here.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: In these towers, humanity is no longer necessary.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What are you even on about...?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Kawalerielki has warriors worthy of fighting. Here, they have warriors worthy of my trust.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Yet they are all resisting this city. The obedient are frail. The rebellious are eternal.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: This is a symbol of civilization's corruption, Knight. We must return to those times of blood and glory.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Son... You're living in the past.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I live in glory.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: That era is not yet behind us, and I hope to experience it tonight.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Well, I've got no more to say to you, then. Margaret will win.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: She has the scent of a hero...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I only hope her talents have not been eroded by the hustle and bustle of this era.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Welcome to the Kazimierz Major, and welcome to tonight's Kazimierz Major!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: As the events continue, we're getting bigger and bigger audiences joining us here in the arena!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I'm honored to announce today that the cumulative spectator count and the total prize pool have once again pushed to the highest numbers in the history of the Major!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: There's no doubt Kazimierz has a bright future ahead!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Can't I go to the arena to watch the match? Margaret should have gotten some tickets, no?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Silly girl. Do you want to be attacked by the Armorless again?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We're openly standing up against the Armorless Union... Do you know what that means?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We have to keep a low profile. If we're going to fight them, we might not even be able to stay in the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Honestly... I really have no idea how things turned out this way.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Hmm... If this isn't...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Czarny's lackey, huh...?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Hello, Sir Tytus.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You can sit.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Becoming a spokesman has really lifted your spirits, hasn't it?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Not at all...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: You were given those orders in such a perilous situation. Did you not find it all strange, under those circumstances?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Mr. Czarny left in such a hurry... There were a lot of things I never had the chance to ask him.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Do you want to ask him?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I'm somewhat well connected with the K.G.C.C... If it pleases you, I can help you find out where Czarny was exiled.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea. Losing to the Radiant Knight again proved to me that I'm not the Tytus Topola who defeated seven knights with one hand anymore.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Before I retire, I have to curry favor with you spokesmen... What's that look for?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: To tell the truth, I never expected this from a man of your caliber. You're the core of the Blade Helmet Knightclub, once a top 4 hopeful, and a candidate for the title of Grand Knight...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I never imagined you would entertain the idea of retirement yourself.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You are so... prideful in the arenas... I thought you would...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: It's not easy to be a competition knight, Malkiewicz. Outside the arena, we're no different than you, and we need an exit strategy.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I'm plenty satisfied just to be able to fight this far with all four of my limbs intact.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: The times for ideals are over, Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: In tonight's match, not only will we get to see two of the biggest names in the tournament duking it out, but we have two independent knights facing off. We haven't seen a spectacle like this in years!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No corporate sponsorship! No knightclub training or support! If they need their helmets polished and weapons sharpened, they have no one to rely on but themselves!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Yet they both stand here today in the arena. And one of them is a former champion! All eyes are on our champ, eager for her return!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Please welcome the young legend, the champion from the Nearl family, the Radiant Knight, MARRRGAREEEEET NEAAAAARRRLLLLLLL!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And on this side, the descendant of a race left on the pages of the history books, a rare Kuranta, war-god scions who flay the years past—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: We could go through the entire history of the knight sports and find no one with purer blood, purer horror, and purer might than him!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Now, here comes the lone wanderer from the grasslands, the last Kheshig, Nightmare Knight TOLAAAAAAAAA!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's this?! The Nightzmora's horn! The match is off to a fiery start! Will the champion fall to the ancient race?! Will this new conquest be cut short by the Radiant Knight?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Let us—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ohh? Nightmare suddenly slammed his spear into the ground. W-What is he doing? Is he saluting his opponent?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I've been waiting for this moment... for far too long.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Kazimierz's knights have been a disappointment.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've heard of you from Master Vogelweide, Nightmare.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What are you seeking?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I am seeking my fate, pegasus.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: All who belong to my ancient race must set off on a Khaganquest when they come of age...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: None of us know what awaits us during our Khaganquest, but it is only when our journey is at an end that our lives have truly begun.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Whether we fight fierce beasts or visit foreign lands, a Nightzmora who finishes his Khaganquest will know its meaning by the journey's end.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Then, we become plumules of terror itself, spreading fear as we make our way across the lands.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Only by knowing the world will we know our destiny.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Have you found your Khaganquest's meaning yet?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Not yet, Pegasus. The road ahead... is like a forest shrouded in fog.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I truly hope that you will be my meaning.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Are you Plastic's... Szewczyk's family?

steps.name: A Quiet Woman
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'm... a knight. A friend of his who's a knight.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Have you... been mistreated in any way at all?

steps.name: A Quiet Woman
steps.text: Mistreated? I'm not sure I follow...

steps.name: A Quiet Woman
steps.text: That day, a knight in white told me that Szewczyk was killed by an enemy he made in the arena.

steps.name: A Quiet Woman
steps.text: After that, she brought us here, and we've been hiding ever since.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I got this from Szewczyk...

steps.name: A Quiet Woman
steps.text: Oh! This is the wood carving I gave him.

steps.name: A Quiet Woman
steps.text: Where is he? Is he doing okay?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'll take you to him.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Let's make a deal.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: As long as you can promise me that you will never again make an enemy of the Armorless Union, I can tell you where your wife is.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: And you, Fartooth. Convey this to everyone in Pinus Sylvestris:

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: There's been some issues within the Armorless Union, even I noticed.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: No one wants to be used for no good reason. That obviously sucks...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Unbelievable.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Can you alone represent the will of the entire Armorless Union? I mean, you may be Platinum—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: But I'm still only middle management, huh?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Yeah, that's the deal... Most of the Armorless were hired by the K.G.C.C. I'm only here to manage things for them... and no one can stop the Board of Directors's plans.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Still though, wouldn't things be a lot easier for you if us middle managers stopped doing anything?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: After all, the Board has been pretty angsty lately, and our new recruits kinda subpar...

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: What's that? It was the Armorless who took out the power?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Roy even wrecked the server room and laid the blame on us.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Is the Armorless Union... trying to shake off the Board's control?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Grr...!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: So we've been used, right from the start?!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Our fight... our sacrifice... all of it—!

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Dejected clicking noises)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After the Candle Knight rescued me, I ran into Ioleta.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: —The Grand Knight?! You met the Grand Knight?!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha, she's a little younger and kinder than she seems on the papers and TV news.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: She agreed to give us all... the legal status we wanted. Our deal still stands.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley, do you have the chip?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Of course...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But, as things stand right now... the public thinks the Infected are the blame for everything that happened...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona, does this 'legal' status actually... mean anything anymore?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Words can't describe how I feel right now—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No doubt all of you are already familiar with the Radiant Knight's strength, but look at Nightmare Knight! See the stunning techniques this warrior of yore has in store for us!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is just unbelievable! Neither of them are using any serious Arts. This is a contest of pure combat and weapon prowess!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is more over-the-top than any action blockbuster I've ever seen. Look at their lightning quick moves, their powerful slashes! It's only been ten minutes, but the whole arena's already absolutely stunned!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Look! Check out Nightmare Knight's moves! He's on the same level as the champions!

steps.name: A Rowdy Spectator
steps.text: I knew he'd be worth keeping an eye on! I spent four hundred on him!

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What an extraordinary match.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: I've never seen anything like the way the Nightzmora wields his weapon.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: It's like the campaign knights' techniques, but also not quite the same... Hm...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What's the matter, Left-hand Knight, sir?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Looks like we have an unexpected guest in the audience... The rumors from the other day are true, then.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What do you mean—Ugh—!
A ray of silver light stands solemnly in the corner of the audience at the very back.
His presence may be matched by none, but even he is engulfed by the audience's cheers and screams.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: It's my first time to watch the Major up close like this...

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: It makes me want to vomit.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: And what's so revolting about this, Liam?

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: I see. I know your answer now.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: In that case, from your point of view, what do you think of these two knights in the arena, the Nightzmora and the pegasus?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: I have to admit... their techniques are beautiful.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: The Nightzmora may not be a battle-hardened veteran, but a certain obsession has driven him to become a true warrior.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: As for Margaret... Hmm...

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: I thought your eyes on this would be sharper than mine, Grandmaster.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: She's far too different... from what she used to be.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Haah...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Hff—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The exhilarating exchange of blows has ground to a halt! This is the first time the storm of battle has paused!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Don't these two need to breathe?! Are these moves even possible for mere mortals?!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Beautiful swordsmanship, pegasus.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Likewise.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You... excite me.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Did you know? According to legend, the Khagan once lost to a pegasus with golden blood, in his younger years.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I'm curious... Is there really a Kuranta in this world with golden blood in her veins?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Sorry to disappoint, but the blood on my face is red.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Warmup is over, Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You live up to your name. And so—
The air is starting to freeze.
It isn't until the audience come back to their senses that they notice they forgot to breathe.
Is it fear?
Why are they afraid?
The entire audience... including all the knights feel a strange sense of repression.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: —Let reality give way to me.
This is the first time Margaret has used her Arts subconsciously in the arena.
The intense radiance is almost like that of the sun, lighting up vast night sky.
Despite the blinding light, the young Nightzmora stands unflinching as ever.
Just as the name implies, a knight competition is nothing but a competition.
However, in this instant, Margaret feels something. It's the same aura that she has felt from her strongest enemies.
Catastrophes, the wails of the Infected, and their roars, the blood of the Infected, and their last struggles on the brink of death.
The young Nightzmora has never seen any mountains of corpses or seas of blood for himself.
Yet his lineage taught him how to control fear the moment he was born.
His pure lineage.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...(Ancient language) The young hunter sets out on his Khaganquest ♪ From dreams he goes, towards the shores of gold ♪

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) A halberd in hand, stained red with blood of kin ♪
A tragic yet heroic song...
...telling an ancient story.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: —Ugh!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Wh-What just happened?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Some kind of Arts?! He used some Arts, and everyone in the arena is feeling a—uh, sensation, I guess!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But! With a single step, Nightmare Knight roused up a blast wave that slammed right into the artificial boulders!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What a fierce strike! The Radiant Knight had no choice but to fall back!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A strike that pushes back a champion! A strike that dispels her light! Even the most radiant of lights cannot stop the Nightzmora's conquest!

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: There's no applause...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Everyone's immersed in... these emotions.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: That strike...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Did you notice something?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Any other knight... would be dead by now.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Uhh...?

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: He's doing this for real.

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: He's the real deal...

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Just a lost child.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: Poor kid.

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (What?! So sudden? You sure? Uhh...)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This just in! The Arts that Nightmare Knight just used have been deemed an adverse effect on our audience members and judges!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is a clear violation of Articles 3 and 7 of the Major's rules!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: 'Competition knights may not harm or threaten the safety of the persons or property of the audience' and 'Competition knights may not in any way interfere with the judges' ability to make subjective rulings!'

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Dammit, this is way too much of a stretch! Couldn't they have at least picked a better time?!)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This match is now over—! So—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: —Come!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Light...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Gather round.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: W-What's going on?! It's like the knights didn't hear our ruling!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The match is over! Separate immediately and wait for the judges!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Ah! What beautiful swordhand!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: In the blink of an eye... Right before my blade could slice your skull, you countered my attack...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You've witnessed death. You've witnessed cruelty. You tremble in the face of neither fear nor me!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Huff...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Strong opponents and insurmountable difficulties do not frighten me.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: On the contrary, the paralysis and degeneracy this city shows even right this moment are much more terrifying than you.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Somebody, stop these two! Pull them apart!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Modern Kazimierz is indeed sickening—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: —Come, let fear open the eyes of these spectators. Show them just what it is they are watching.
That's enough.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: —What?
A figure reminiscent of blood fissures the earth.
The ground between the two is cleaved apart by a giant axe appearing from thin air.
I said: that's enough.
The match is over...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's you... The Blood Knight.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Who could have known?! No one could possibly have anticipated that the one who would finally put a stop to this unstoppable battle would be—!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: 'Kazimierz's Crimson Goblet', the hero, Dikaiopolis! It's not an easy name to remember, but be sure not to take your eyes off this—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That's the champion of the Kazimierz Major, undoubtedly the most popular of them all, the god of war from Minos! THE—BLOOOOOOOOOD—KNIIIIIIIIIGHT!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Man, thank goodness he showed up. Guess I put on a decent enough show today? Hey, one of you, go check on the spokesman and tell me how he's reacting!)

steps.name: 'A Silverlance Pegasus'
steps.text: Dikaiopolis... A Minoan name. So he's the Infected who took the title three years ago.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: This is my first time seeing the Blood Knight fight in person too... What a potent aura.

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Whoa! The Blood Knight leaped into the arena! And he's walking toward our brawling contestants!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's been years since Kazimierz has seen something like this!! Two champions! We have two champions on the same stage! What a sight to behold!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Of course, of course! The man standing on the other side isn't exactly your average Józef either, having just demonstrated his immense strength. What's more, that's Kazimierz's last Nightzmora we're talking about—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This here, everyone, is a million dollar marvel! Do not ever forget this moment! This is one for the history books!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You... another champion...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Your next opponent is me, Nightzmora.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: And my next opponent is you.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Hah... hahaha... I sense you imply I will lose to you.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Absolutely.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: How will a phantom who lives in the past possibly defeat me?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You, Infected, I look forward to the day I fight against you.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Do you think you can just walk away?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: –––Hraagh!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Nightzmora, you should understand that you can only instill fear in those who live in the 'present'.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: (He managed to deflect that strike from such an angle...?)

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: We will meet on the field.
Margaret turns around to look at the axe-marked ground.
The Blood Knight walks over to retrieve his weapon.
It seems as though blood is spilling out of the lifeless fissure in the earth.
